crossshulkersort.btn.label: Q
crossshulkersort.btn.tooltip:
One-click Shulker Box sort
Packs loose items into plain shulker boxes and consolidates across boxes to use fewer of them
Hold Shift and drag to move this button
crossshulkersort.start: Sorting started: %s eligible boxes, planning to use %s
crossshulkersort.done.leftover: , %s stacks exceeded the total box capacity and could not be packed
crossshulkersort.done.nothing: Nothing to sort (no eligible plain shulker boxes, or already optimal)
crossshulkersort.err.inv_full: No empty slot in the main inventory/hotbar: at least 1 empty slot is required to start sorting
crossshulkersort.err.no_qs: Quick Shulker not detected - cannot open shulker boxes, sorting aborted
crossshulkersort.err.qs_disabled: Quick Shulker refused to open the box: check that its "Open Shulker Box" option is enabled
crossshulkersort.err.open_fail: Timed out while opening a shulker box, sorting aborted (make sure Quick Shulker works in this world)
crossshulkersort.err.stuck: Sorting stopped early: the remaining items exceed the total capacity of all shulker boxes (or the inventory cannot be freed right now), the rest is done
crossshulkersort.err.internal: Internal error: slot mapping failed, sorting aborted
crossshulkersort.err.carried: An item is on the cursor - sorting cancelled (put it back first; avoid running other inventory mods' sorts at the same time)
crossshulkersort.err.container: Sorting works from the inventory screen only: close the open container and press Q again
crossshulkersort.config.title: Cross Shulker Sort Settings
crossshulkersort.config.needCloth: Install Cloth Config to see detailed settings
crossshulkersort.config.note: Applies instantly in singleplayer; on servers the server config file wins
crossshulkersort.config.includeDyed.tool: Dyed shulker boxes also take part (default: plain ones only)
crossshulkersort.config.includeNamed.too: Named boxes or ones with special NBT also take part (default: skipped)
crossshulkersort.config.includeLockedFul: Full 27-slot single-type boxes are re-sorted too (default: skipped as optimal)
crossshulkersort.config.bulkMinStacks.to: Types using at least this many slots count as bulk: packed first, may span boxes (default 6)
crossshulkersort.config.bulkFirst.toolti: Off = pure Item Scroller order, no size priority
crossshulkersort.config.homeHealing.tool: Move strays into each type's fullest box
Full boxes spill into the next box with room
crossshulkersort.config.defragEnabled.to: Pulls split types together when room can be made without new splits
crossshulkersort.config.defragBulkEnable: Packs over-one-box bulk types into the fewest boxes
crossshulkersort.config.topUpEnabled.too: Fills partial stacks to max from same-type leftovers
crossshulkersort.config.reservationEnabl: Unstackables live in their own trailing boxes, never mixed
crossshulkersort.config.maxRounds.toolti: Quiet extra rounds until the layout stops changing (default 3)
crossshulkersort.config.buttonX.tooltip: Offset from the inventory GUI top-left (or Shift-drag it directly)
crossshulkersort.config.buttonY.tooltip: Offset from the inventory GUI top-left (or Shift-drag it directly)
crossshulkersort.config.chatReport.toolt: Off = errors only, no finished messages
crossshulkersort.config.debugLog.tooltip: Off = quiet logs; turn back on to reproduce an issue
